scope:
Native auto-trim success/failure entry surface on physical 1-g sources.

Spatial exploration only, not a flight or a maximum certificate. The retained
request can only come from reset or an actual earlier successful update; this
maps candidate successful outputs without declaring their paths reachable.

pitch_response.method: Native steady pitch moment derivative at fixed flight state; normal control sign
